d:
Some melodies never lose their magic! Enjoy the evergreen classic "Kitne Bhi Tu Karle Sitam" from the film Sanam Teri Kasam, featuring the magical voice of Asha Bhosle and the unforgettable composition of R.D. Burman. Starring Kamal Haasan and Reena Roy, this timeless song beautifully captures the musical brilliance of an era filled with unforgettable melodies.
Kitne Bhi Tu Karle Sitam - Asha Bhosle | Sanam Teri Kasam | RD Burman | Reena Roy, Kamal Hassan Hits
Song: Kitne Bhi Tu Karle Sitam (Male)
Movie: Sanam Teri Kasam (1982)
Star Cast: Kamal Haasan, Reena Roy
Singer: Asha Bhosle
